title: Choosing File Formats in ETL Pipelines

scenes.say: Ever wonder why there are so many data file formats? Which one should you actually use in your ETL pipeline?

scenes.label: CSV/JSON
scenes.sub: Text-based, easy to use, but slow for big data.
scenes.say: CSV and JSON are simple and human-readable. Great for small jobs, but they slow down fast with large data.
For analytics, Parquet and Avro shine. They're binary and columnar, so queries and storage are much more efficient than CSV or JSON.

scenes.label: Delta/Iceberg
scenes.sub: Add ACID transactions and schema evolution.
scenes.say: Delta and Iceberg take Parquet further. They add ACID transactions and handle schema changes, perfect for production data lakes.

scenes.question: Is CSV best for big analytics jobs?
scenes.right: Nope! Parquet or Delta are much better for speed and features.
scenes.say: Don't fall for this one. CSV is simple, but for big analytics, Parquet or Delta are way more efficient.
